title: John Alexander's book finds no Majestic group

tellings.quote: his book about UFOs, he claims that he never found any group like Majestic

plain: In his book about UFOs, John B. Alexander, a man who looked into the subject from inside the US government's world, says he never found any group like Majestic, the secret panel some people believe was set up to manage the UFO question in the highest circles. The philosopher Jason Jorjani brings this up with Michels as his own summary of the book, which he does not date, alongside the work of the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée; the book reports that Alexander did not find such a group, and whether that means none exists, the summary does not settle.
